correctness.rationale: In the geodesically convex horoball quotient C_w=(R/wZ)×[0,∞) with metric dt²+e^(−2t)dx², independent normalized-area heights have Exp(1) laws. Their absolute difference S~Exp(1) is independent of minimum height M~Exp(2), and the shortest circular separation U~Unif[0,w/2] yields Z=Ue^(−M), triangular density 4/w(1−2z/w). The quotient distance satisfies cosh D=cosh S+Z²e^(−S)/2. For R≥2asinh(w/4), quadratic roots place v_-≤1≤v_+, giving exact conditional survival 1/[cosh R+√(sinh²R−z²)]; integrate over Z. Uniform fixed-w expansion yields e^(−R)+(w²/24)e^(−3R)+(w²/24+w⁴/120)e^(−5R)+O_w(e^(−7R)); check E[Z²]=w²/24,E[Z⁴]=w⁴/240. Scaling Z=wV couples widths strictly for all R>0; the leading tail gives exponential-moment cutoff p<1. Independent quadrature and direct geometric coordinate checks corroborate selected widths/radii, not universal analysis.
